METHODOLOGY

How to read this list

Value created

We use each company’s market capitalization at year-end 2024 as a snapshot of its equity value, sourced from CompaniesMarketCap. That figure reflects share prices and the number of shares outstanding. Many people helped build that value, and each profile highlights one leader connected to the company.

Discussion that inspired the list

People employed

This counts people working directly for the company or its subsidiaries on the reporting date, including people who joined through acquisitions. Figures come from annual reports and Stock Analysis, generally from fiscal 2024 or the first half of 2025. Some people can appear in more than one company’s total where reporting overlaps. Each profile links its source.

Estimated annual pay to workers

This estimates the total pay that supports workers’ livelihoods over a year. We multiply the number of people employed by an assumed yearly pay per person in USD. The assumption draws on the industry and, in some cases, the company’s home country. Actual pay varies by role and location. Use the slider on each profile to see how changing the assumption affects the estimate.

Operating locations

Company globes show selected locations. Amazon’s map adds net sales by market, estimated GDP contributions and investment by U.S. state, and reported measures for selected facilities. The employment and pay figures at the top of each profile cover people worldwide. The globe geography comes from Natural Earth. U.S. state boundaries come from the Census Bureau through US Atlas. Photo credits and licenses appear on each profile.
